description: Save sections to one of the user's boards on regards.design, so they keep what they liked and find it there later. keys are section keys ("page/section", hit.key), up to 24. board is a board's id or name; a name that matches none of their boards makes a new board with it. Left out, the board saved to last (a first save makes one called "My board"). New sections go first on the board; one already on it stays where it is. The answer says what was added, what was there already and any key that isn't a published section. The plan sets how many boards the user keeps and how many sections each holds: a save that doesn't fit saves nothing and says why.

board.description: A board's id, or its name as the user calls it ("Pricing").

keys.description: Section keys ("page/section"), as search results give them (hit.key).

name: save_to_board

already.description: Keys that were on the board already.

shared.description: Whether anyone with its link can open it (the user turns sharing on and off on its page).

url.description: Its page on regards.design: the user's own, and anyone's while it is shared.

created.description: Whether this save made the board.

missing.description: Keys that aren't published sections: nothing was saved for them.

title: Save sections to a board
